description: Turn a verbose JSON CLI into a condensed MCP: small CLI verbs, JSON as the contract, MCP compresses related verbs into one tool.

steps.title: Split the CLI into small verbs
steps.do: Give each action its own command and flags (create, add-step, edit-step, remove-step). Do not invent a kitchen-sink CLI command.

steps.title: Put work in ops that return dicts
steps.do: Implement file mutations in one ops layer. Every function returns a JSON-serializable dict. CLI and MCP both call this layer.

steps.title: Print JSON from every CLI command
steps.do: stdout is json.dumps of the ops dict (ok, valid, errors, titles, ids). No prose tables as the machine contract. Humans can still read the JSON.

steps.title: Treat JSON as the MCP contract
steps.do: MCP tool results are the same ops dicts, serialized as JSON text. Do not invent a second response shape for MCP.

steps.title: Add MCP as a thin stdio server
steps.do: JSON-RPC over stdio. tools/call runs the same ops as the CLI. Do not reimplement mutations inside the MCP handlers.

steps.title: Condense MCP tools
steps.do: Do not mirror CLI 1:1. Collapse related verbs into one MCP tool with an op (add|edit|remove). CLI stays verbose; MCP compresses.
